task:
A gross settlement of 2205 credits is reduced by 15%. The reduced figure includes a 30% fee measured on its fee-free base; remove that included fee by division. Then add 7% of the ORIGINAL gross settlement. What is the exact result? Do not round. After computing that result, apply these further settlement adjustments IN ORDER, with no rounding:
Adjustment 1: add 9 credits, then discount the whole amount by 13%.
Adjustment 2: apply a 6% surcharge, then subtract 3 credits.
Adjustment 3: add 9 credits, then discount the whole amount by 5%.
Adjustment 4: apply a 6% surcharge, then subtract 22 credits.
Adjustment 5: add 6 credits, then discount the whole amount by 10%.
Adjustment 6: apply a 8% surcharge, then subtract 21 credits.
Adjustment 7: add 14 credits, then discount the whole amount by 18%.
Adjustment 8: apply a 17% surcharge, then subtract 10 credits.
Adjustment 9: add 10 credits, then discount the whole amount by 6%.
Adjustment 10: apply a 5% surcharge, then subtract 25 credits.
Adjustment 11: add 27 credits, then discount the whole amount by 19%.
Adjustment 12: apply a 14% surcharge, then subtract 13 credits.
Adjustment 13: add 20 credits, then discount the whole amount by 8%.
Adjustment 14: apply a 6% surcharge, then subtract 17 credits.
Adjustment 15: add 19 credits, then discount the whole amount by 9%.
Show intermediate steps, with one line for each follow-on stage in the form Amount after adjustment <n>: <exact value>. End with Final answer: <reduced fraction, or integer if its denominator is one>.
